assertions.subject: Radial nerve injury
assertions.predicate: weakness of extension of the wrist and fingers
assertions.quote: Radial nerve injury classically presents with weakness of extension of the wrist and fingers (“wrist drop”) with or without more proximal weakness of extensor muscles of the upper extremity, depending on the site of injury.

assertions.subject: Radial nerve injury
assertions.predicate: sensory loss in the distribution of the radial nerve
assertions.quote: Sensory loss is in the distribution of the radial nerve, which includes the dorsum of the hand (Fig. 463e-3A).
